verdict.rationale: First-party docs show Rootly generating AI insights from the customer's own incident data inside the product. This includes AI Summaries built from metadata, alerts, timeline and transcripts; an in-app Ask Rootly AI chat grounded in live incident context; AI SRE diagnoses with recommended next steps; related-incident matching; and AI-drafted retrospective blocks. These are available in the web app, Slack and mobile. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of output quality (community evidence does not address the AI features).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: AI Summaries writes it for you, from what the incident already knows: metadata, alerts, timeline events, action items, and (when permitted) Slack messages and meeting transcripts.
Answers are grounded in that incident's live context: its timeline, alerts, chat history, and bridge-call transcripts.
Rootly AI SRE investigates active alerts and incidents, tests likely causes against live evidence, and gives responders a reviewable diagnosis with recommended next steps.
Rootly AI matches your incident against everything your team already solved.
an AI block is a section, such as What Happened or Contributing Factors, that Rootly AI drafts for you from the incident's own context.
